title: Why Hiring Fast Is Killing Startups Right Now? #shorts
description: @danshipper7738 founder of Every, explains how his media and product company operates with just 15 people — without writing a single line of code himself. He breaks down why staying lean beats over-hiring, how AI-native companies should approach building today, and why so many well-funded startups are setting themselves up to fail by scaling headcount too early. A must-watch for founders thinking about how to build in the AI era without burning capital or bloating their team.
